name: Pipeliners - Review Widget Coverage 2026-08-19
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-08-19

# Summary
Crawl of 124 sitemap pages (all 200) to see where the GoHighLevel/LeadConnector reputation widget appears (5.00 average, 123 Google reviews, location `EiTihyrdd2j8bFW4xpe2`). A CSV of the same data sits beside it (`Pipeliners-Review-Widget-Coverage-2026-08-19.csv`).

# Key findings
- Only 4 pages carry it: homepage, /about-us/, /trenchless-drain-pipe-repair/, /epipe-restoration/.
- 0 of 37 city pages, 0 of 53 blog posts, 4 of 15 service and conversion pages.
- Tier 1 to add: /free-sewer-inspection/, /contact/, /services/, /services-areas/, /trenchless-pipe-repair-service-areas-in-arizona/. Tier 2: core service and guide pages.
- Caveat: the widget is an iframe, so it adds no indexable content or schema and shows the same reviews everywhere. For city pages the file recommends native, city-specific review text instead.

# Follow-up
A Google reviews block was added to 36 city pages on Aug 26 (see the design audit note).
